maria: Quick check-in — profiling from last night's canary shows repeated OOM spikes during batch assembly when KV cache pressure > 78%. Kernel handoffs spike and p99 latency increases ~15%. Dump below, flagging the batch admission path.

maria: Key observations: short-lived batches get preempted more often, eviction/sec climbs, and kernel selection flips to fallback kernels during high KV pressure.

maria: Profiling snippet:
```
KVWatermark=0.78
ActiveBatches=24
AvgBatchTokens=320
Evictions/sec=12
KernelHandoffs=3.4%
p99_latency_ms=142 -> 165 (after handoff)
MemoryFreeMB=420
BatchAdmissionFailures=18
```

alex: Thanks — is the canary using the default token target? i.e. `--batch-token-target=512` on those hosts? If so let's try 256 for KV-heavy machines and compare.

jon: We hit a similar pattern on r4 last quarter. What helped then was preemptive eviction + early admission holdqueue. Two knobs that worked: lower token-target and enforce `--kv-evict-threshold=0.72` so eviction starts before admission floods memory.

sachi: Also consider adjusting kernel routing policy: prefer the quantized kernel for long sequences under KV pressure (less scratch memory). That change reduced memory footprint ~10% in microbenchmarks. I can PR an opt-in route.

maria: Plan: run two quick canaries tonight — A) token-target=256 + kv-evict=0.72, B) token-target=256 + kernel-prefer-quant. Compare eviction/sec, KernelHandoffs, p99 latency. cc @sachi

ci-bot: deployer: canary started on pool runtime-canary-03 (build 1.7.12).

alex: :thumbsup: Also add a short-term alert: fire if KVPressure > 70% && p95_latency_delta > 10% within 5m so we don't burn through capacity.

jon: If canary looks good, we should add an admission path that limits batch tokens for requests that would pull KV pages > XMB — basically a conservative small-batch admission for KV-hot requests.

maria: Agreed. I'll collect the metrics after the run and post back. If we see improvements I'll open a follow-up RFC for admission policy + kernel routing.

sachi: FYI I'll start the kernel routing draft and a small benchmark matrix.

maria: Thanks team — will update in the morning.
